honesty_notes: Representable counts remain assessment-sense only: nothing is translated, compiled or verified; `verified` is unreachable under the current contracts.
The largest single deficit in Reactotron (63 hook elements) is programme debt, not Goya demand; ADR 0001 (oxc-based extractor 0.2.0) is the proposed remedy and is unimplemented.
Fiddle's desktop-OS and persistence deficits include template/test-file populations that a future scope mechanism will reclassify; the current numbers are declared, not cleaned.
GY-DESKINT/1 and GY-PERSIST/1 are proposals; until ratified, the pending rules stay unapplied and their codes unemitted.
